description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog component, verifying its symbol generation based on device properties such as device family, model identifier, and friendly name. It also tests the presentation layer's ability to use bundled model mappings.

methods.name: symbol prefers model identifier prefixes
methods.description: Verifies that the symbol method prioritizes model identifier prefixes for device types such as iPad and iPhone.

methods.name: symbol uses friendly name for mac variants
methods.description: Checks that the symbol method correctly uses the friendly name for Mac devices to determine specific symbols.

methods.name: symbol falls back to device family
methods.description: Ensures that if no specific model information is available, the symbol defaults to using the device family.

methods.name: presentation uses bundled model mappings
methods.description: Tests that the presentation method correctly retrieves device presentation info based on bundled model mappings.
